description: Single, wages and interest: full standard deduction and exemption, three-rate schedule
working: Maine AGI = federal AGI = 72,000. Standard deduction (single, 2026) = 15,700; AGI is below the 102,250 phase-out threshold, so in full. Personal exemption = 5,300 (AGI below 341,000). Taxable = 72,000 - 15,700 - 5,300 = 51,000. Schedule #1: 51,000 is in the 27,400-64,850 band: 5.8% x 27,400 = 1,589.20, plus 6.75% x (51,000 - 27,400 = 23,600) = 1,593.00; tax = 3,182.20 (the MRS table rounds the base to $1,589, giving 3,182). No dependents, no surcharge.
